name: Media Render & Transcode Service
actions: transcode allowlisted formats through an optional adapter
summary: Render deterministic audio and natively transcode PCM WAV with bounded jobs, progress, cancellation and review handoff; optional FFmpeg expands formats.
notes: The core has zero third-party dependencies. FFmpeg is a free open-source optional adapter for MP3/WebM/MP4, codec arguments are fixed, sources stay under assets or exports, and completed output is never published automatically.
